title: Making a Beach Safety Guide
paras: Each spring, a small island council makes a beach safety guide for visitors. Work begins at an informal [[get-together|get-together]] in the harbour office. While staff eat [[porridge|porridge]] from bowls on a wooden [[tray|tray]], beach workers describe problems from the previous summer. Their stories help the team decide what visitors need to know.

First, writer Mina collects advice from rescue workers. A person may feel [[brave|brave]] enough to enter deep water despite being afraid, but courage cannot replace swimming skills. [[secondly|Secondly]], she checks details about each beach. Visitors who want to [[surf|surf]] need to know where boards are allowed. She also includes advice about avoiding [[mosquito|mosquito]] bites near the wet grass behind the sand.

Next, an artist draws a simple map with safe swimming areas in green. Dangerous rocks are [[obviously|obviously]] important, so they appear as large black shapes rather than tiny marks. The team keeps the text short: [[roughly|roughly]] forty words for each beach. Mina saves the finished pages on the office computer's hard [[disk|disk]] and sends a copy to the printer.

Before printing hundreds of guides, the team folds one paper sample and takes it outside. Can the map be read in bright sunlight? Does it fit inside a pocket? After a few changes, the guide is ready to help visitors enjoy the island safely.
zh: 每年春天，一座小岛的议会都会为游客制作海滩安全指南。工作从港口办公室里的一次非正式聚会开始。工作人员吃着放在木托盘上的碗里的燕麦粥，海滩工作人员则讲述去年夏天遇到的问题。这些经历帮助团队确定游客需要了解什么。
首先，撰稿人米娜向救援人员征求建议。一个人虽然害怕，却可能鼓起勇气进入深水区，但勇气不能代替游泳技能。其次，她核查每片海滩的具体信息。想冲浪的游客需要知道哪些地方允许使用冲浪板。她还写入了如何在沙滩后方潮湿的草地附近避免蚊虫叮咬的建议。
接着，一位画师绘制简明地图，用绿色标出安全游泳区。危险的礁石显然很重要，因此用较大的黑色图形表示，而不是细小的标记。团队尽量保持文字简短，每片海滩的介绍约四十词。米娜把完成的页面保存在办公室电脑的硬盘上，并向印刷方发送一份副本。
在印制数百份指南之前，团队先折好一份纸质样本，带到户外查看。地图在强烈的阳光下能看清吗？指南能装进口袋吗？经过几处修改，指南终于可以帮助游客安全地游览小岛了。

q.s: The meeting in the harbour office lasts two hours.
q.why: 文章未说明港口办公室聚会的时长。

q.s: Mina includes advice on avoiding mosquito bites in the guide.
q.why: 第二段明确说她加入了防蚊叮咬的建议。

q.s: The map uses small symbols to show dangerous rocks.
q.why: 危险礁石用较大的黑色图形而非小标记表示。
